pcm_comparison.native_exit_scope: Both persistent runtimes are killed/reaped by NativeRuntime.close; their -9 exit is cleanup, not a graceful normal exit.
pcm_comparison.scope: Exact raw PCM equivalence for the tested four excerpts/windows only. Fixed runtime order and thermal/startup differences prevent causal timing-overhead, live service-latency, perceptual-quality or GPU-timestamp claims.

loaded_diagnostic.graph_phase_scope: CPU-wall upload/compute/readback intervals of accepted delivered requests; compute includes explicit backend wait. Empty/missing fields are null/unavailable, never zero-filled. Comparison timings are excluded.

cancellation.scope: Wait 150 ms after the supervisor started event, then revalidate generation/request. No GPU submission timestamp is observed.

virtual_playback.scope: Virtual frame-clock consumption with one held playing chunk and at most two worker-ready chunks; independent silent audio probe, no physical stem playback

coverage.scope: Independent silent audio probe streaming interval; no stem playback claim

audio.scope: Callback execution and PipeWire-reported driver-position clock timing; not measured end-to-end audio latency, per-stream xrun recovery or a complete graph xrun count.
audio.signal_scope: Independent silent audio probe. No physical latency, complete graph-xrun, stem playback or musical-quality inference.

frame_observation.scope: GUI-thread frameSwapped notifications; not physical presentation latency

coverage.minute_bin_scope: Complete 60-second UI-observation bins overlapping the workload; partial final UI bins are excluded

progress.exposure_scope: Sampled heartbeat exposure; spans end at recovery or workload stop, or remain open during the run

coverage.scope: GUI-thread frameSwapped notifications and initialized heartbeat with a 30-second unexposed budget; not physical presentation latency

UI.scope: GUI heartbeat/frameSwapped notifications and sampled exposure; not physical display presentation latency.

thermal.scope: All retained native-trace samples, including any startup/shutdown outside the stated workload span. 85C counts describe observations, not an added thermal pass gate. Consecutive spans and row brackets use timestamps recorded after capture, not precise sensor-read times. Capture-conservative brackets run from preceding below-threshold capture start to following below-threshold row timestamp; missing capture starts remain unavailable. Brackets describe sampled excursions, not continuous temperature or all unseen peaks; gaps are not filled or asserted safe.

source_acceptance.parity_scope: Full same-grid chunks require identical SHA-256; trimmed seeks use allclose(rtol=1e-4, atol=1e-5) and record exact equality/max difference.
source_acceptance.active_cancel_scope: Wait 150 ms after the supervisor started event, then revalidate generation/request. No GPU submission timestamp is observed.
source_acceptance.scope: prepared WAV corpus playback-paced delivery with requested load=both; no stem playback/full deck or musical-quality claim

loaded_diagnostic.scope: Observed 600-second diagnostic only. Target unmet. Generic animated Harness UI plus independent silent audio; no actual CDJ stem playback, physical audio latency, musical-quality, GPU-preemption or sustained-hour qualification claim. Brief sampled heat is reported without adding a thermal gate.

ambient_observation.scope: Two-second ambient CPU snapshot during preflight only; no native workload active. No processes or settings changed.
ambient_observation.causal_scope: One short ambient snapshot cannot attribute every spike or quantify the process during a future workload. No applications or settings were changed.

coverage_CI.scope: Separate CI instrumented functional run, not hardware timing or whole-product coverage.

initial_loaded_preflight.scope: Preflight observations only. No loaded worker/audio/UI run started; no thermal-soak pass/fail or release qualification is inferred.

derivation.percentile_method: nearest rank ceil(n*p/100)-1, matching stem_worker.percentiles; consecutive requests are not independent tail samples
derivation.deduplication: Accepted soak_hop records only, matched to source chunk/started events; continuous population excludes the explicit seek-first delivery.
derivation.thermal_precision: Row timestamp brackets and capture-conservative brackets are separate. The latter uses preceding below-threshold capture start to following below-threshold row timestamp; neither proves absence of unseen peaks.

secret_scan.scope: Uncompressed local retry-02 result directory, including the 7.68 MB native trace; separate from the commit hook scan.

native_memory_before_close.scope: This native process peak resident memory; not GPU or graph-buffer memory.
This native process peak resident memory; not GPU or graph-buffer memory.

native_point_observations.scope: Exact PID/start identities, native point observations only. Capture intervals can overlap phases. Zero-MHz points do not show sustained low-clock inference. No whole-request clock, continuous temperature or energy claim.
